abs_approvals_nsw.title: NSW dwelling approvals by type
abs_approvals_nsw.description: ABS Building Approvals (dataflow BA_GCCSA): NSW dwelling units approved, houses and dwellings excluding houses, original, monthly from 2015.
abs_approvals_nsw.schedule: Checked every day at 11:52am Sydney time by the scheduled refresh, and updated when the publisher releases new figures.

abs_approvals_regions.title: Approvals, Sydney vs regions
abs_approvals_regions.description: ABS Building Approvals (dataflow BA_GCCSA): total dwelling units approved in Greater Sydney and Rest of NSW, original, monthly.
abs_approvals_regions.schedule: Checked every day at 11:52am Sydney time by the scheduled refresh, and updated when the publisher releases new figures.

abs_approvals_states.title: Dwelling approvals by state
abs_approvals_states.description: ABS Building Approvals (dataflow BA_GCCSA): total dwelling units approved by state and Australia, original, monthly.
abs_approvals_states.schedule: Checked every day at 11:52am Sydney time by the scheduled refresh, and updated when the publisher releases new figures.

abs_completions.title: NSW dwelling commencements, completions
abs_completions.description: ABS Building Activity (dataflow BUILDING_ACTIVITY): NSW dwelling units commenced and completed, total residential, original, quarterly from 2015.
abs_completions.schedule: Checked every day at 11:52am Sydney time by the scheduled refresh, and updated when the publisher releases new figures.

abs_completions_states.title: Dwelling completions by state
abs_completions_states.description: ABS Building Activity (dataflow BUILDING_ACTIVITY): dwelling units completed, total residential, original, by state and Australia, latest eight quarters.
abs_completions_states.schedule: Checked every day at 11:52am Sydney time by the scheduled refresh, and updated when the publisher releases new figures.

abs_cpi_monthly.title: CPI growth, monthly
abs_cpi_monthly.description: ABS monthly Consumer Price Index (dataflow CPI): all groups, through-the-year per cent change, Sydney and eight capitals.
abs_cpi_monthly.schedule: Checked every day at 11:52am Sydney time by the scheduled refresh, and updated when the publisher releases new figures.

abs_cpi_quarterly.title: CPI index, quarterly
abs_cpi_quarterly.description: ABS Consumer Price Index (dataflow CPI): all groups index, Sydney and weighted average of eight capital cities, original, quarterly from 2014.
abs_cpi_quarterly.schedule: Checked every day at 11:52am Sydney time by the scheduled refresh, and updated when the publisher releases new figures.

abs_exports.title: NSW merchandise exports
abs_exports.description: ABS International Trade (dataflow MERCH_EXP): NSW goods exports, 12-month sums in $m, total and top destinations and SITC commodity divisions.
abs_exports.schedule: Checked every day at 11:52am Sydney time by the scheduled refresh, and updated when the publisher releases new figures.

abs_gdp.title: Australian GDP growth
abs_gdp.description: ABS National Accounts (dataflow ANA_AGG): gross domestic product and GDP per capita, chain volume, seasonally adjusted, per cent change on the previous quarter, from 2015.
abs_gdp.schedule: Checked every day at 11:52am Sydney time by the scheduled refresh, and updated when the publisher releases new figures.

abs_gsp_states.title: Gross state product by state
abs_gsp_states.description: ABS Australian National Accounts: State Accounts: real gross state product growth and GSP per capita growth by state and territory, latest financial year (2024-25, released 20 November 2025).
abs_gsp_states.schedule: Checked every day at 11:52am Sydney time by the scheduled refresh, and updated when the publisher releases new figures.

abs_interstate.title: NSW interstate migration
abs_interstate.description: ABS National, state and territory population (dataflow ERP_COMP_Q): NSW net interstate migration (persons), interstate arrivals and departures ('000), quarterly from 2015.
abs_interstate.schedule: Checked every day at 11:52am Sydney time by the scheduled refresh, and updated when the publisher releases new figures.

abs_labour_nsw.title: NSW labour force, monthly
abs_labour_nsw.description: ABS Labour Force (dataflow LF): NSW unemployment rate, participation rate and employed persons ('000), seasonally adjusted and trend, with the Australian unemployment rate (seasonally adjusted), monthly from January 2015.
abs_labour_nsw.schedule: Checked every day at 11:52am Sydney time by the scheduled refresh, and updated when the publisher releases new figures.

abs_labour_states.title: Labour force by state
abs_labour_states.description: ABS Labour Force (dataflow LF): unemployment rate and employed persons by state and Australia, seasonally adjusted, latest 14 months.
abs_labour_states.schedule: Checked every day at 11:52am Sydney time by the scheduled refresh, and updated when the publisher releases new figures.

abs_population.title: Estimated resident population
abs_population.description: ABS National, state and territory population (dataflow ERP_Q): estimated resident population, persons, quarterly. NSW from 2014, Australia from 2018, other states latest six quarters.
abs_population.schedule: Checked every day at 11:52am Sydney time by the scheduled refresh, and updated when the publisher releases new figures.

abs_sfd_nsw.title: NSW state final demand
abs_sfd_nsw.description: ABS National Accounts (dataflow ANA_SFD): NSW state final demand, chain volume measures $m, seasonally adjusted and trend, quarterly from 2015.
abs_sfd_nsw.schedule: Checked every day at 11:52am Sydney time by the scheduled refresh, and updated when the publisher releases new figures.

abs_sfd_states.title: SFD and investment by state
abs_sfd_states.description: ABS National Accounts (dataflow ANA_SFD): state final demand and private business investment, chain volume $m, seasonally adjusted, latest eight quarters.
abs_sfd_states.schedule: Checked every day at 11:52am Sydney time by the scheduled refresh, and updated when the publisher releases new figures.

abs_spending.title: Household spending growth
abs_spending.description: ABS Monthly Household Spending Indicator (dataflow HSI_M): total household spending, current price, seasonally adjusted, through-the-year per cent change, NSW and Australia.
abs_spending.schedule: Checked every day at 11:52am Sydney time by the scheduled refresh, and updated when the publisher releases new figures.

abs_spending_states.title: Household spending by state
abs_spending_states.description: ABS Monthly Household Spending Indicator (dataflow HSI_M): through-the-year per cent change by state, latest four months.
abs_spending_states.schedule: Checked every day at 11:52am Sydney time by the scheduled refresh, and updated when the publisher releases new figures.

abs_wpi.title: Wage price index growth
abs_wpi.description: ABS Wage Price Index (dataflow WPI): total hourly rates of pay excluding bonuses, through-the-year per cent change, original: NSW all sectors, NSW private, NSW public and Australia, quarterly from 2015.
abs_wpi.schedule: Checked every day at 11:52am Sydney time by the scheduled refresh, and updated when the publisher releases new figures.

abs_wpi_states.title: Wage growth by state
abs_wpi_states.description: ABS Wage Price Index (dataflow WPI): through-the-year per cent change, all sectors, by state and Australia, latest eight quarters.
abs_wpi_states.schedule: Checked every day at 11:52am Sydney time by the scheduled refresh, and updated when the publisher releases new figures.

asic_insolvency.title: ASIC company insolvencies
asic_insolvency.description: ASIC insolvency statistics Series 1, Table 1.3: companies entering external administration for the first time, NSW and Australia, by month.
asic_insolvency.schedule: Checked each weekday at 12:23pm Sydney time through the Claude desktop app on your computer; ASIC publishes monthly.

bond10.title: 10-year bond yield, monthly
bond10.description: RBA table F2.1: 10-year Australian Government bond yield, monthly average, read through the open-source NSW Economic Dashboard pipeline on GitHub.
bond10.schedule: Checked every day at 11:52am Sydney time by the scheduled refresh, and updated when the publisher releases new figures.

budget_aggregates.title: Budget aggregates, 2026-27
budget_aggregates.description: NSW Budget 2026-27, general government sector: revenue, expenses, budget result, taxation, interest, capital expenditure ($b), net and gross debt and superannuation provision at 30 June. BP1 Tables 1.2, 6.1, A.1, A.2 and budgeted financial statements open data.
budget_aggregates.schedule: Fixed to the 2026-27 NSW Budget; rebuilt when NSW Treasury publishes the next fiscal update. The daily refresh checks for one.

budget_facts.title: Ratings and fiscal facts
budget_facts.description: Credit ratings (Moody's, Fitch, S&P), infrastructure program totals, transfer duty revision, first home buyer duty assistance and labour productivity figures, each row citing its source.
budget_facts.schedule: Fixed to the 2026-27 NSW Budget; rebuilt when NSW Treasury publishes the next fiscal update. The daily refresh checks for one.

budget_history.title: Fiscal history since 2000-01
budget_history.description: NSW general government revenue, expenses, budget result, net debt and interest expense, $b, 2000-01 to 2029-30. BP1 2026-27 Tables E.6 and E.7.
budget_history.schedule: Fixed to the 2026-27 NSW Budget; rebuilt when NSW Treasury publishes the next fiscal update. The daily refresh checks for one.

capital_by_agency.title: Capital program by agency
capital_by_agency.description: NFPS capital spending by agency group, $m, 2026-27 and four-year total to 2029-30. BP3 Table 1.3.
capital_by_agency.schedule: Fixed to the 2026-27 NSW Budget; rebuilt when NSW Treasury publishes the next fiscal update. The daily refresh checks for one.

capital_programs.title: Top capital programs
capital_programs.description: Largest NSW capital programs by value with publicly released cost information and completion dates, plus other major projects. BP3 2026-27 Chapter 2 key project tables, Box 2.18 and Chapter 4 agency tables; value_b ranks by ETC where published, otherwise expenditure to 30 June 2026 plus the four-year program.
capital_programs.schedule: Fixed to the 2026-27 NSW Budget; rebuilt when NSW Treasury publishes the next fiscal update. The daily refresh checks for one.

expense_mix.title: Expenses by type, 2026-27
expense_mix.description: General government expenses by type, $m, 2026-27 Budget. BP1 Table A.1 (budgeted financial statements).
expense_mix.schedule: Fixed to the 2026-27 NSW Budget; rebuilt when NSW Treasury publishes the next fiscal update. The daily refresh checks for one.

exports_fy.title: NSW exports, 2024-25
exports_fy.description: NSW goods exports (ABS MERCH_EXP, state of origin, July 2024 to June 2025) by main commodity and top five partners, and services exports by state (ABS International Trade: Supplementary Information, Financial Year 2024-25, released 17 December 2025).
exports_fy.schedule: Fixed to the 2026-27 NSW Budget; rebuilt when NSW Treasury publishes the next fiscal update. The daily refresh checks for one.

nab_survey.title: NAB business survey
nab_survey.description: NAB Monthly Business Survey: national business conditions and confidence (net balance, seasonally adjusted) and capacity utilisation, latest month.
nab_survey.schedule: Checked every day at 11:52am Sydney time by the scheduled refresh, and updated when the publisher releases new figures.

news.title: NSW economy headlines
news.description: Google News headlines on the NSW economy, budget, housing and cost of living for the past two weeks, collected by the open-source NSW Economic Dashboard pipeline on GitHub.
news.schedule: Checked daily; the source pipeline updates headlines each Monday.

news_themes.title: Headline themes
news_themes.description: Number of NSW economy headlines by theme over the past two weeks, from the same open-source pipeline.
news_themes.schedule: Checked daily; the source pipeline updates headlines each Monday.

outlook.title: Economic outlook, 2026-27 Budget
outlook.description: NSW economic performance and outlook: 2024-25 outcomes and Treasury forecasts to 2029-30. BP1 2026-27 Table 2.1.
outlook.schedule: Fixed to the 2026-27 NSW Budget; rebuilt when NSW Treasury publishes the next fiscal update. The daily refresh checks for one.

property_sydney.title: Sydney median home values
property_sydney.description: Cotality Home Value Index: Sydney median values for houses, units and all dwellings, with monthly and annual change.
property_sydney.schedule: Checked every day at 11:52am Sydney time by the scheduled refresh, and updated when the publisher releases new figures.

rba_cash_rate.title: RBA cash rate target
rba_cash_rate.description: Reserve Bank of Australia cash rate target at each change since February 2019, from rba.gov.au/statistics/cash-rate.
rba_cash_rate.schedule: Checked every day at 11:52am Sydney time by the scheduled refresh, and updated when the publisher releases new figures.

rba_fx.title: Australian dollar, daily
rba_fx.description: RBA exchange rates: US dollars per Australian dollar and the trade-weighted index at 4pm Sydney time, each trading day from 4 November 2026.
rba_fx.schedule: Checked every day at 11:52am Sydney time by the scheduled refresh, and updated when the publisher releases new figures.

refs.title: Reference dates and targets
refs.description: Dates and targets drawn on charts: the 25 March 2023 NSW election, and the NSW National Housing Accord target of 377,000 homes over five years from 1 July 2024 (75,400 a year).

releases.title: Upcoming data releases
releases.description: Scheduled release dates for the figures on this dashboard, from the ABS release calendar, the RBA Monetary Policy Board schedule, and the NAB and Cotality release patterns.
releases.schedule: Checked every day at 11:52am Sydney time by the scheduled refresh, and updated when the publisher releases new figures.

revenue_mix.title: Revenue by source, 2026-27
revenue_mix.description: General government revenue by source, $m, 2026-27 Budget. BP1 Tables 4.1 and 4.5 (other grants combine other Australian Government payments and other grants).
revenue_mix.schedule: Fixed to the 2026-27 NSW Budget; rebuilt when NSW Treasury publishes the next fiscal update. The daily refresh checks for one.

taxation.title: Taxation by type, 2026-27
taxation.description: General government taxation revenue by tax, $m, 2025-26 revised and 2026-27 budget, with shares of taxation and total revenue. BP1 Table 4.4.
taxation.schedule: Fixed to the 2026-27 NSW Budget; rebuilt when NSW Treasury publishes the next fiscal update. The daily refresh checks for one.
